# .github

GitHub infrastructure for git-lanes enforces CI/CD execution via `workflows/`, dependency management via `dependabot.yml`, and contribution standards via `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`.

## Behavioral Contracts

Commit messages for dependencies must use `chore(deps):` prefix for `npm` and `chore(ci):` for `github-actions`. `dependabot.yml` sets `open-pull-requests-limit` to 5 per ecosystem. `CODEOWNERS` matches `*` glob pattern to `@bugracakmak` reviewer. `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` lists `Bug fix`, `New feature`, `Refactoring`, `Tests`, `CI/CD` as valid change types.

## CI/CD Architecture

`ci.yml` runs matrix strategy on `ubuntu-latest`/`macos-latest` with `bun-version: latest` executing `test/unit`, `test/security`, `test/integration`, `test/e2e`. `publish.yml` triggers on `v*` tags requiring `secrets.NPM_TOKEN` and `id-token: write` permission for `npm publish --provenance`. `release-notes.yml` utilizes `softprops/action-gh-release@v2` with `generate_release_notes: true` on `ubuntu-latest`. `ci.yml` defines `ci-complete` job validating `needs.test.result` equals `success`. `publish.yml` chains `test` job before `publish` job.

## Workflow & Conventions

Security policy mandates array args for spawn in workflow definitions. `dependabot.yml` assigns `dependencies` label for `npm` PRs and `ci` label for `github-actions` PRs. Issue forms enforce `area` dropdown categories: Session Management, Conflict Detection, Test Runner, CLI, Hooks / Adapters, Configuration, Forge / PR Creation, Other. Bug reports must follow 7-step sequence including `duplicate` checkbox, `os` + `versions`, `what-happened`, `steps`, `expected` behavior, `logs`.
